Basso]][[The High Republic — The Blade 1|''The High Republic — The Blade'' 1]] {{C|assistant editor}} *[[Danny Khazem]] {{C|editor}} |publisher=[[Marvel Comics]] |start date=[[December 28]], [[2022]]{{PenguinComics|url=book/?isbn=75960620492200111|text=STAR WARS: THE HIGH REPUBLIC - THE BLADE 1}} |end date=[[March 29]], [[2023]]{{PenguinComics|url=book/?isbn=75960620492200411|text=STAR WARS: THE HIGH REPUBLIC - THE BLADE 4}} |schedule= |format=Miniseries |issues=4 |timeline=[[382 BBY]]The [[The High Republic — The Blade 1|first issue]] of ''Star Wars: The High Republic — The Blade'' is set "a [[Standard century|century]] and a half" before the [[Destruction of Starlight Beacon|fall of Starlight Beacon]], dated to [[230 BBY]] by ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'', and the [[The High Republic — The Blade 2|second issue]] takes place after the ceasefire of the [[Eiram and E'ronoh War]], dated to [[382 BBY]] by ''Timelines''. Furthermore, Porter Engle is dispatched to the [[siege of Bardotta]] in the [[The High Republic — The Blade 4|fourth issue]], and {{SWYouTube|6_701eyzskI|Jedi Master Porter Engle: Characters of Star Wars the High Republic|sw_url=video/jedi-master-porter-engle-characters-of-star-wars-the-high-republic}} states that the siege earned him the nickname "Blade of [[Bardotta]]," an event dated to 382 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]] by ''Timelines''. Therefore, ''The Blade'' series is set in 382 BBY. |series= |preceded by= |followed by=''[[Star Wars: The High Republic: The Broken Blade]]''[[The High Republic — The Blade 4|''The High Republic — The Blade'' 4]] }} '''''Star Wars: The High Republic — The Blade''''' is a comic miniseries featuring [[Jedi]] [[Porter Engle]] published as part of Phase II of the ''[[Star Wars: The High Republic]]'' multimedia project. The series was written by [[Charles Soule]] and the [[The High Republic — The Blade 1|first issue]] was published by [[Marvel Comics]] on [[December 28]], [[2022]]. Set around [[382 BBY]], it focuses on the involvement of [[Jedi Master]]s [[Porter Engle]] and [[Barash Silvain]] in the [[Siege of Firevale|attack on Firevale]], a conflict that occurred on the [[planet]] [[Gansevor]]. {{Comics-stub}}
